verses.text_en: And I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment going, and they held scourges and chains of iron and bronze.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio kako prolaze vojske anđela kazne držeći bičeve i lance od željeza i bronce.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘To whom are these who hold the scourges going?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom: „Kamo idu ovi što drže bičeve?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘To their elect and beloved ones that they may be cast into the chasm of the abyss of the valley.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „K njihovim izabranima i miljenicima, da ih bace u ponor dolinskoga bezdana.

verses.text_en:
And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved,
And the days of their lives shall be at an end,
And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će se ta dolina napuniti njihovim izabranima i miljenicima,
dani njihova života doći će kraju,
a dani njihova zavođenja više se neće brojiti.

verses.text_en:
And in those days the angels shall return
And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes:
They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them,
And they shall rouse them from their thrones,
That they may break forth as lions from their lairs,
And as hungry wolves among their flocks.
verses.text_hr:
U one će se dane anđeli vratiti
i obrušiti se na istok, na Parte i Međane.
Uznemirit će kraljeve i duh će nemira doći na njih,
podići će ih s njihovih prijestolja,
da provale poput lavova iz svojih brloga
i poput gladnih vukova među svoja stada.

verses.text_en:
And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones,
[And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway]:
verses.text_hr:
Uzaći će i zgaziti zemlju njegovih izabranih,
[a zemlja njegovih izabranih bit će pred njima poput gumna i široke ceste].

verses.text_en:
But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses.
And they shall begin to fight among themselves,
And their right hand shall be strong against themselves,
And a man shall not know his brother,
Nor a son his father or his mother,
Till there be no number of the corpses through their slaughter,
And their punishment be not in vain.
verses.text_hr:
Ali grad mojih pravednika bit će zapreka njihovim konjima.
Počet će se boriti jedni protiv drugih,
a njihova će desnica biti snažna protiv njih samih.
Čovjek neće poznavati svojega brata
niti sin svojega oca ili majku,
sve dok se zbog njihova pokolja više ne budu mogla izbrojiti trupla
i njihova kazna ne bude uzaludna.

verses.text_en:
In those days Sheol shall open its jaws,
And they shall be swallowed up therein,
And their destruction shall be at an end;
Sheol shall devour the sinners in the presence of the elect.’
verses.text_hr:
U one će dane Šeol razjapiti čeljusti
i oni će biti progutani u njemu.
Njihovo će uništenje biti dovršeno;
Šeol će pred izabranima proždrijeti grešnike.“
